title: Widen PinFlowController's catch scopes and add a finally so busy never sticks true on an untyped PinService exception

evidence.quote:
state = state.copyWith(busy: true, errorMessage: null);
        await pinService.setProfilePin(profileId, pin);

why: PinFlowState hand-rolls AsyncValue's job via a `busy`/`errorMessage` pair instead of AsyncNotifier+AsyncValue.guard, and the hand-rolled error handling is incomplete: _handleSetup catches only ArgumentError, _handleChange's verifyCurrent and _handleVerify catch only PinLockoutException, and _handleChange's confirm step (line 350-351, the PIN-CHANGE save call) has no catch at all. appendDigit/backspace both early-return while `state.busy` is true, so any OTHER exception from PinService.setProfilePin/verifyProfilePin (a bcrypt hashing error, a DB write failure, disk full) leaves busy stuck true forever, permanently freezing the parent-PIN keypad with no error shown and no way to recover short of an app restart. This is the load-bearing PIN gate for parent/settings access.
recommendation: Wrap each of the 4 call sites in a catch-all (or a `finally { if (state.busy) state = state.copyWith(busy: false); }`) in addition to the existing typed catches, and route the generic-exception case to `state.copyWith(busy:false, errorMessage: <generic error>)` instead of leaving busy uncleared.
acceptance_criteria: Every code path through _handleSetup, _handleChange (all 3 async steps), and _handleVerify guarantees state.busy is false after the method returns, on both success and any exception type.

Regression test: a fake PinService that throws a generic StateError (not ArgumentError/PinLockoutException) from setProfilePin/verifyProfilePin in each of the 4 sites; assert state.busy == false and state.errorMessage != null afterward, and that appendDigit still accepts input.

Rule-0 checker: extend tool/ audit greps to flag a `busy: true`/`loading: true` state assignment in a Notifier method that is not followed by an unconditional reset before the method's closing brace (heuristic grep for `copyWith(busy: true` without a paired `finally`).

refutations: Evidence quotes are literally accurate (verified at lines 283, 324, 350-351, 397), and SM-5's grep target (try/catch assigning state in a @riverpod Notifier, hand-rolled instead of AsyncValue.guard) does match this file. But the severity narrative is dishonest: 3 of the 4 cited call sites (line 324'
corrections: The claim 'no way to recover short of an app restart' is false and overstates severity. parent_pin_keypad_dialog.dart's PinKeypadDialogFrame wires PopScope(canPop:false) and the X close button's onPressed to `onClose` UNCONDITIONALLY (not gated on `busy` -- only the digit/backspace/keypad-cancel buttons check `busy`). Tapping close or the back gesture calls _popResult -> router.pop, exiting the frozen screen. Re-entering the PIN flow creates a new PinFlowScreen with a fresh _mountToken, and initializeForMount() detects the token mismatch and fully resets PinFlowState (busy:false) -- no app restart needed, just close-and-retry. The underlying defect (silent failure, no error shown, current entry attempt lost) is still real and rule-violating, but it's a recoverable UX/reliability bug, not a permanent app-breaking freeze, so I'm downgrading from P1 to P2.

3 of the 4 cited call sites (pin_flow_controller.dart:324, :350-351, :397 — all inside _handleChange/_handleVerify) sit behind PinFlowChangeRoute/PinFlowVerifyRoute, which are defined in app_router.gr.dart but never invoked from any production or test code path (confirmed via repo-wide grep) — i.e. dead code, not 'the load-bearing PIN gate for parent/settings access' as claimed. The real live parent-PIN verify/change UI is a separate widget, ParentPinKeypadDialog/showParentPinChangeDialog (settings_screen.dart:661), untouched by this finding. Only the _handleSetup site (line 283), reachable via PinFlowSetupRoute for first-time/post-wipe PIN creation only (pin_guard.dart:103, settings_screen.dart:668-671 guarded by `!_hasPin`), is a genuine live-code SM-5/busy-stuck risk. Downgrade from P1 to P2 (narrow, first-run-only design debt) and confidence to SUSPECTED since 75% of the evidenced sites and the central severity justification do not hold in shipped code; the recommendation to fix all 4 sites is still reasonable hygiene but should not be sold as fixing a load-bearing gate.</evidence_correction>

3 of the 4 evidence sites (pin_flow_controller.dart:324, :350-351, :397, inside _handleChange and _handleVerify) are unreachable in production — PinFlowMode.change/verify are never triggered because PinFlowChangeRoute/PinFlowVerifyRoute are never pushed anywhere in lib/ (confirmed by grep and by the already-verified sibling finding in verified-findings-r3.json recommending their deletion). Only line 283 (_handleSetup, ArgumentError-only catch, reachable via PinFlowSetupRoute) is a live production site.
